title: Meeting Spielberg about a video game in the middle of the dispute
summary: Bryce Zabel tells of Meeting Spielberg about a video game in the middle of the dispute, about 1996 at Amblin, Los Angeles, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Bryce Zabel, a Hollywood television writer and producer, says that in 1996, in the middle of a dispute, he went to Amblin, the Los Angeles film company of the famous director Steven Spielberg, to meet about a video game. He says he waited in Spielberg's office until Spielberg came in, shook his hand and said, "Great to see you again." He tells it as part of his story about how Hollywood and UFO stories have crossed paths.
